description: Manually verified retrieval evaluation set for Phase 4. Each question is paraphrased (not copied verbatim from the SQL examples) to test semantic generalization. The 'relevant' lists are the ground-truth knowledge chunks that SHOULD be retrieved, curated by hand against knowledge_base/ (glossary metrics, unsupported metrics, verified examples, and schema tables). Recall@K measures how many of these appear in the top-K results.
